card.name: Kidney function cutoffs and renal terms
card.fires_on: The word or space right after a kidney-function threshold phrase such as eGFR less than or below, just before the number. Also the word after 'with' or 'due to' in kidney or low-pressure conditions.

modes.label: Before eGFR cutoff number
modes.description: The blank space after 'less than' or 'below' in an eGFR limit, right before 30 or 45.
modes.example: Do not use in patients with eGFR below<< >>30 mL/min/1.7

modes.label: Condition word after with/due to
modes.description: An adjective that starts a condition name, like low, chronic or renal, after 'with' or 'due to'.
